final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/app.log by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC in the required format, uppercased the level, extracted the message after the service name on the first line, and extracted the last line of any traceback or set it to null if none. I also accounted for repeated messages by summing the repeat counts from the special repeated message lines. Finally, I aggregated the counts by service and wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure following Acme log-triage conventions.
